WITH clock AS (SELECT public.olap_reporting_date() today),
 available AS (SELECT min("Date") starts FROM public.reporting_statement_calendar),
 selected AS (
 SELECT d."Date" FROM (SELECT generate_series(DATE '1900-01-01',DATE '2199-12-31',INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS "Date") d
 WHERE [[{{performance_period}} --]] d."Date" BETWEEN (SELECT starts FROM available) AND (SELECT today FROM clock)
 ), bounds AS (SELECT min("Date") starts,max("Date") ends,count(*) days,
 count(*)>0 AND count(*)=max("Date")-min("Date")+1 continuous FROM selected),
 live_days AS (SELECT d."Date" FROM selected d CROSS JOIN bounds b CROSS JOIN clock c WHERE b.continuous AND d."Date"<=c.today),
 history_days AS (SELECT d."Date" FROM selected d CROSS JOIN bounds b CROSS JOIN clock c WHERE b.continuous AND d."Date"<c.today) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM live_days) THEN (SELECT coalesce(sum(s."Interest Paid"),0) FROM {{#71}} s JOIN live_days d ON s."Payment Date"=d."Date") END AS "Gross interest"

 available AS (SELECT min("Date") starts FROM public.reporting_statement_calendar),
 selected AS (
 SELECT d."Date" FROM (SELECT generate_series(DATE '1900-01-01',DATE '2199-12-31',INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS "Date") d
 WHERE [[{{performance_period}} --]] d."Date" BETWEEN (SELECT starts FROM available) AND (SELECT today FROM clock)
 ), bounds AS (SELECT min("Date") starts,max("Date") ends,count(*) days,
 count(*)>0 AND count(*)=max("Date")-min("Date")+1 continuous FROM selected),
 live_days AS (SELECT d."Date" FROM selected d CROSS JOIN bounds b CROSS JOIN clock c WHERE b.continuous AND d."Date"<=c.today),

 SELECT d."Date",s."Snapshot ID",s."Generated At",s."Profit" AS "Gross interest",s."Principal Issued" AS "Principal issued",
 s."Principal Returned" AS "Principal returned",s."Loans Issued" AS "Loans issued",s."Active Loans EOD" AS "Active loans EOD",

 count(*)-count("Snapshot ID") AS "Missing snapshots" FROM history GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

 s."Principal Returned" AS "Principal returned",s."Loans Issued" AS "Loans issued",s."Active Loans EOD" AS "Active loans EOD",
 s."Active Borrowers EOD" AS "Active borrowers EOD" FROM history_days d LEFT JOIN {{#74}} s ON s."Date"=d."Date"), totals AS (SELECT min("Date") starts,max("Date") ends,count(*) n,count("Snapshot ID") covered,

visualization_settings.text: Selected-period results · live on report refresh
Hourly refresh: yesterday. Older corrections need a rebuild.
Weekly = principal ÷ loans. Partial weeks use selected days only.
End-of-day counts use loan/close dates; do not sum across dates.

source_policy: Live selected-period totals for any date; completed-day snapshots only for trends/detail. Original Performance unchanged.
